column1: # gpu/nvidia/checks/ports.tsv: what became of each file of CUDApp tests/ and tools/ that is not Omega.
# PATH<tab>ported|retired|blocked<tab>DETAIL. ported: the Omega check named in DETAIL replaces it (gpu/nvidia/checks/checks.tsv).
# retired: nothing in omega-mv will run it; DETAIL says why. blocked: it tests code that has no Omega unit yet; DETAIL names it.
# A path not listed here is open. gpu/nvidia/checks/inventory.om reads this file and fails on a row naming no CUDApp path.

column3: leftovers (gpu/nvidia/checks/leftovers.om, table leftovers.tsv from the C at CUDApp 84b524ca, see gpu/nvidia/checks/README.md, Oracles; not ported: the NULL-pointer cases, C-binding only, and the acquire, release and poison state changes of the C atomic omega_numeric_native_state, host C state with no Omega unit)
gdn_admit (gpu/nvidia/checks/gdn_admit.om, table gdn_admit.tsv from the C oracle src/omega_gpu_gdn_admit.c and omega_gdn_shape at CUDApp 84b524ca, same domain as the C test)
gpu/nvidia/checks/mutants.tsv rows for check leftovers (its five pathcopy.om mutants, each as the one line it changes; the gate requires each to compile and to fail the check)

streams (gpu/nvidia/checks/streams.om, table streams.tsv from the C oracle emit_chunk_c, pair_marker, channels_c and xq_admit_c at CUDApp 84b524ca over the C test's whole domain: every chunk configuration of the sweep, every channel value class, every extra queue index and open set; not ported: the CUDAPP_STREAMS_DIFF_LOG hook, C-binding logging)

gemm_policy (gpu/nvidia/checks/gemm_policy.om, table gemm_policy.tsv from the pending C host policy gx_min, gx_arow, gx_bcol, gx_brow and gx_pack and the test's own formulas for ops 4 to 6, at CUDApp 84b524ca over the C test's whole domain, each distinct case once; not ported: the gx_conv copy-shell comparison and the typed-view refusal, which test the C memcpy shell around the row unit, not the policy)

gpu/nvidia/checks/mutants.tsv rows for check gemm_policy (its eight policy.om mutants, each as one line; the two that change two lines are written as the one-line change that drops that op) and the gate's table control for its red comparator; not ported: the missing-unit link negative, the gcov report and the make runs of other tests, which concern the C build

fmt (gpu/nvidia/checks/fmt.om, table fmt.tsv written by glibc snprintf through the C mode of this file at CUDApp 84b524ca, at the default size of tests/tools-om/fmt.sh: its special values one row per conversion and its 40000 splitmix64 doubles as FNV-1a-64 digests of every printed byte, the doubles regenerated by the check; not ported: the om mode, which links the bridge-emitted C of fmt.om, where the check calls fmt.om itself)

fmt (gpu/nvidia/checks/fmt.om: its differential at its default size; its flipped-record control is the gate table control; its six fmt.om mutants are gpu/nvidia/checks/mutants.tsv rows for check fmt, with two more; not ported: the bridge-seeded build of the om mode, which concerns the C binding)

api_ew (gpu/nvidia/checks/api_ew.om, table api_ew.tsv from the C shape plan ap_c and the retained C generator build_kernel at CUDApp 84b524ca over the C test's whole domain: every instruction field, register count and width, and acceptance of each spec; not ported: the allocation, encoded text and cubin comparisons after the C replay shell, which run in C)

gpu/nvidia/checks/mutants.tsv rows for check api_ew (its five ew_ir mutants, each as the one line it changes, with three more); not ported: the bwrap device guard and the bridge regeneration of the C binding, which concern the C build
